{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df_completed['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df_completed['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any parsing errors
print(df_completed['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum())

# Drop any rows where revenue could not be parsed
df_completed_clean = df_completed.dropna(subset=['revenue_numeric'])

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
print(df_completed_clean['revenue_numeric'].value_counts().get(999999.99, 0))"}
